questions.q: Deleting a file with Shift+Delete in Windows Explorer:
options: Deletes it permanently without moving it to Recycle Bin
questions.solution: Shift+Delete bypasses the Recycle Bin and permanently deletes the file (after confirmation). Plain Delete sends it to the Recycle Bin.
questions.shortcut: Add Shift = skip the bin. That single fact answers most Recycle-Bin questions.

questions.q: The number of layers in the OSI reference model is:
questions.solution: OSI has 7 layers (Application to Physical). The TCP/IP model that the Internet actually uses has 4.

questions.q: The hexadecimal number 2F equals which decimal number?
questions.shortcut: F=15: so 32+15 = 47. Options built from F=5, 7 or 13 are the traps.

questions.q: Which of the following is system software?
questions.solution: Windows 11 is an operating system - system software that manages the machine. PowerPoint, Photoshop and Tally are application programs that run on top of an OS.
questions.shortcut: The OS is the platform everything else installs on; look for Windows/Linux/macOS/Android among the options.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My uncle ___ in Pune since 2018.
questions.solution: *since 2018* marks an action that began in the past and continues now, so a perfect (continuous) tense is needed: **has been living**. Simple present, present continuous and past continuous cannot be used with *since* here.
questions.shortcut: since/for → perfect tense; only one option is perfect.

questions.q:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error.

Neither the manager nor / the employees was / present at / the monthly meeting.
questions.solution: With *neither... nor*, the verb agrees with the nearer subject — *employees* (plural) → **were** present. *Was* wrongly agrees with the distant singular subject.
questions.shortcut: Or/nor pair → match the second subject.

questions.q:
Select the word which is nearest in meaning to the given word.

TENACIOUS
questions.solution: *Tenacious* = holding on firmly, refusing to quit → **persistent**. 'Fragile' and 'sluggish' are the planted opposite-temperament options.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To smell a rat
questions.solution: A hidden rat betrayed by its smell = a hidden deceit betrayed by signs → **to suspect trickery**. 'To detect a thief red-handed' overshoots — smelling a rat is suspicion, not proof.

questions.q: Why do steam burns cause more severe injuries than boiling water at the same temperature?
options: Steam is at a higher pressure
Steam releases extra latent heat when it condenses
questions.solution: Steam at 100 °C gives out its **latent heat of vaporisation** (about 2,260 J per gram) as it condenses on skin, in addition to the heat released by cooling. Boiling water gives only the cooling heat.

questions.q: The dry, dusty Harmattan wind, locally called 'The Doctor', blows over:
questions.solution: The **Harmattan** blows from the Sahara over **West Africa** towards the Guinea coast. Its dryness brings relief from humid heat, hence 'The Doctor'. Egypt has the Khamsin, France the Mistral and California the Santa Ana.

questions.q: Which organelle is known as the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.solution: **Mitochondria** carry out aerobic respiration and produce **ATP**, the cell's energy currency — hence 'powerhouse'. Ribosomes make proteins and lysosomes are the 'suicide bags'.

questions.q: The **Hornbill Festival**, called the 'festival of festivals', is held every December in —
questions.solution: The Hornbill Festival is held from **1 to 10 December** at Kisama Heritage Village near Kohima, **Nagaland**, showcasing all Naga tribes.

questions.q: The average of the first 10 natural numbers is:
A is 3 times as fast a worker as B and takes 24 days less than B for the same work. If they work together, the work is completed in:
questions.solution:
Times: $x$ and $3x$ with $3x - x = 24$ ⇒ $x = 12$ (A = 12, B = 36).
Together: $\frac{1}{12} + \frac{1}{36} = \frac{4}{36} = \frac{1}{9}$ ⇒ 9 days.
questions.shortcut: Difference of times = 2 units = 24 ⇒ A 12, B 36; ab/(a+b) = 9.

questions.q: A, B and C invest ₹20,000, ₹15,000 and ₹25,000 respectively in a business. C joined the business 4 months after its start. If the total profit at the end of the year is ₹46,500, find C's share.
questions.shortcut: C worked only 8 months. Capital-months 12 : 9 : 10 ⇒ C gets 10/31 of ₹46,500 = ₹15,000.

questions.q: In a workforce of 4,800, the pie chart shows two departments occupying 15% and 25% of the circle. The number of employees in these two departments together is:
questions.shortcut: Add the shares first: 40% of 4800 = 1920. One multiplication, not two.

questions.q: In which option is the figure given in the question **embedded** as a part (rotation is not allowed)?
questions.figure: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 34 34" width="34" height="34" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="5" y1="17" x2="17" y2="5"/><line x1="17" y1="5" x2="17" y2="17"/><line x1="17" y1="5" x2="29" y2="5"/><line x1="17" y1="17" x2="17" y2="29"/></svg>
questions.solution: The part is a / slant rising to a point, a horizontal line going right from that point and a vertical line going down from it. Only the first figure has the / slant cutting the top-left corner exactly where the vertical line meets the top edge; the top edge supplies the horizontal line. The second has the slant the other way; in the third no vertical line goes down from the upper end of the slant; in the fourth the slant is at the bottom.
questions.shortcut: Look for the part's most unusual stroke first; reject options where it is missing or runs the wrong way.

questions.q: If **÷ means +**, **+ means −**, **× means ÷** and **− means ×**, then the value of **16 ÷ 4 + 3 × 6 − 2** is:
questions.solution: Substituted: 16 ÷ 4 + 3 × 6 − 2 → **16 + 4 − 3 ÷ 6 × 2**. BODMAS: 3÷6×2 = 1 (left to right); 16 + 4 − 1 = **19**. The value 20 belongs to the un-substituted expression (4 + 18 − 2) — the mapping-ignored trap.
questions.shortcut: Rewrite all four operators first; handle the ÷/× run (3 ÷ 6 × 2) left to right.

questions.q: In a colony of newspaper readers, **45 people read the Herald, 25 read both the Herald and the Tribune.** How many read **only the Herald**?
questions.solution: Only Herald = 45 − 25 = **20**.

questions.q: Select the related letters: **DOG : GRJ :: CAT : ?**
questions.solution: G−D = +3, R−O = +3, J−G = +3 (positions). The rule is a constant **+3** shift. C(3)+3 = F(6), A(1)+3 = D(4), T(20)+3 = W(23) → **FDW**.
questions.shortcut: One subtraction row gives (+3, +3, +3); add to the probe cluster using EJOTY anchors.
